property_summary: A successful transferFrom call always returns true.
The transfer function never reverts when called with valid parameters.
The transfer function returns the same value as the success of the last internal call (or always true when all calls succeed).
After a successful transfer call, the balance of each recipient increases by exactly v.
The transfer function returns true when all internal calls succeed.
After transfer, the number of calls to transferFrom is equal to the length of _tos.
After calling transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v), the return value is true (always).
After calling transfer, the contract's balance remains unchanged (no ether transferred).
The return value of transfer is false when _tos length is zero.
After calling transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v), the return value is true regardless of the input parameters.
The transfer function returns true when called with a non-empty _tos array.
The transfer function returns true when _tos is not empty.
The transfer function always returns true when called with _tos.length > 0.
The transfer function reverts when called with an empty _tos array.
